ImageDescription.value:
Another in a three part series of homes I took footage for in Sept-Oct 2019. This is another of my Uncles homes in Addison, VT. I love how the colors pop in this footage, looks more real than in person! Here you get some good panoramic shots of the surrounding Vermont landscape. As opposed to the other footage by the lake, this was much more 'fun' to fly since there wasn't the worries of hitting all those trees or crashing to a watery end.

I put the drone in sport mode for the shots where we fly down to the back edge of the property and back, we hit 40+mph on that shot as well. I am attempting to be more smooth in my transitions, such as the 360 around the home, but I really feel this needs more work.

The footage took very little editing, since the first take was pretty spot on, but I did experiment with adding graphics (title/credit/etc) and some music track to keep it a bit more interesting.

Hope you enjoy.

ImageDescription.value:
Kinburn Spit. Regional Landscape Park

Black Sea in Ukraine Kínburn Foreland or Kinburn Spit – a spit in Ochakiv Raion (district) of Mykolaiv Oblast at the Black Sea in Ukraine. It occupies the western part of the Kinburn Peninsula, being its natural extension stretching west into the Black Sea between the Dnieper-Buh estuary and the Bay of Yahorlyk. Its length is about 40 km, width – 8–10 km. In southern Ukraine, the Kinburn Foreland is often mistaken for being the entirety of the Kinburn Peninsula, of which it appears to be a part.

Now it is well-known because of its unique nature but centuries ago this place was webbed with exciting events, stories, legends.

Oleksandr Kabanov. DJI Phantom 4. 09/2016

ImageDescription.value:
The Lala Lake, a crystal tear within the Eastern Carpathians landscape, appears in its entire splendour: Ineu Peak on top, dominating the entire area and on the bottom, the valley which takes your breath away due to the beauty of the landscape.

Located in the Eastern Carpathians, in Rodna Mountains, at almost 1,800 meters altitude in a glacial valley, Lala lake is part of the Mixed Reservation “Ineu-Lala” and it also has a younger/smaller sibling nearby, the Lala Mic Lake.

ImageDescription.value:
Newsreels in which Dutch subjects of a certain week are presented.
The KLM opens a regular service between the Netherlands and America. The Douglas DC-4 Skymaster PH-TAR "Rotterdam" departs from Schiphol Airport for the first flight to New York. SHOTS: - the journey of the ship "De Halve Maan" (The Half Moon) from the Netherlands to America and the foundation of the colony New Amsterdam at the Hudson estuary in 1609 is visualised with prints and an old sea chart; - departure from Schiphol Airport: ext. airplane; captain Evert van Dijk talks to KLM director H. Martin; passengers board the plane, a.o. a Polygoon Camera for Neerlands Nieuws (Dutch News); crew poses; airplane takes off; - during the flight: several aerial shots: Schiphol Airport, landscape, clouds, IJmuiden, the Dutch and Scottish coast, sunset above the clouds, Statue of Liberty, suspension bridge across the bay; skyscrapers; shots of the wings with engines and turning propellers; int. airplane: crew in the cockpit; radio operator talks in the microphone; passengers in the cabin: talking to each other, looking out the window, receiving a cup of tea, sleeping; - stop over at Prestwick airport, where the plane is refueled and then departs again; - passengers leave the airplane in America; - edited in between these shots: flying shots and the landing of another Skymaster, the PH-TAS.
